hook.text: The *2027* tax numbers just came out.

beats.kicker: Gift to anyone in 2027, no gift tax return

beats.sub: 2027 numbers are for next year's paychecks and plans.

cta.sub: We'll DM you our 2027 tax calendar.

captions.instagram:
The IRS released the 2027 tax numbers on November 5. The ones most people will notice:

✔️ Standard deduction: $16,600 single, $33,200 married filing jointly, $24,925 head of household.
✔️ Annual gift exclusion: $20,000 per person you give to (up from $19,000).
✔️ Health FSA paycheck limit: $3,500.
✔️ These are for tax year 2027. The return you file next spring still uses the 2026 numbers.

Save this for open enrollment and your 2027 planning.

Source: IRS news release IR-2026-133. General information, not advice for your situation.
